rationale: Description: SIT on floor with back against wall BASE (low on wall, seated upright), bend both knees up, rest forearms on raised knee, tilt head back against wall. Current globalTilt=-80 is near-supine (lying back) — too reclined for seated. Changed globalTilt -80→-20 (upright seated with slight back-lean). spine -14→-5 (less back arch). Symmetric legs: leftHip/rightHip 100/70→110/110 (more hip flexion for raised knees), leftKnee/rightKnee 120/80→130/130 (symmetric deep knee bend). Arms: increased elbows 81/60→150/150 (deeply bent for forearms to reach knees), shoulderFwdL/R 2/5→-50/-50 (arms forward in body-frame to knees). Result: head_z -0.915→-0.379 (✓ at wall, less reclined), shoulder_z -0.677→-0.278 (✓ back against wall), wristL_to_kneeL 0.515→0.312 (improved but slightly over 0.30 threshold — rig limitation: elbow is rotY only, cannot bring forearm horizontally to knee from seated position). Knees raised symmetric (y=0.319).
